name: 复古打字机
description: 羊皮纸底 #F5E8C7 + 墨棕 #2C2416 + Courier 等宽 + 双横线 H1 + 稿纸行距。打字机怀旧手稿感，全局等宽字体、p 行距 1.9、H1 上下双细线夹（打字机标题），hr 短破折号。vs terminal 黑底绿字未来感，本主题是羊皮纸怀旧派。适合旧体散文/手账/信件体/回忆录。

styles.h1: font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #2C2416; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 38px; margin-bottom: 26px; border-top: 2px solid #2C2416; border-bottom: 2px solid #2C2416; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h2: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #2C2416; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 14px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #2C2416; letter-spacing: 2px;
styles.h3: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #8B4513; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h4: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #2C2416; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-style: italic;
styles.h5: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #5A4530; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.55;
styles.h6: font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #8A7659; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
styles.p: font-size: 15px; color: #2C2416; line-height: 1.9; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: background: #EDE0B8; border: 1px dashed #2C2416; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 13px; color: #5A4530; line-height: 1.85; font-style: italic;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 13px; color: #5A4530; line-height: 1.85; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent; font-style: italic;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; display: block; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; border: 2px solid #2C2416; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 0; border: none; border-top: 2px dashed #2C2416; width: 80%; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;
styles.code: background: #E8DBA8; border-radius: 0; font-size: 92%; color: #2C2416; font-family: 'Courier New','Courier',monospace; border: 1px solid #8B4513;
styles.pre: background: #EDE0B8; border: 2px solid #2C2416; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #2C2416; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.75; white-space: pre-wrap;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; background: #2C2416; color: #F5E8C7; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'Courier New',monospace;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #2C2416; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Courier New','Courier',monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 13px; border: 2px solid #2C2416;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 700; color: #F5E8C7; background: #2C2416; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px;
styles.li: font-size: 14px; color: #2C2416; line-height: 1.9; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
